description: Minimal is a Jekyll theme for GitHub Pages

summary.one_liner: Minimal is a Jekyll theme for GitHub Pages sites, provided as a remote theme that can be enabled through a site's _config.yml.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a Jekyll theme that GitHub Pages users can apply to a site by adding a remote_theme entry and the jekyll-remote-theme plugin to _config.yml. The site title and description are read from _config.yml, with optional settings for a download URL toggle and a Google Analytics tracking ID. Custom styling is supported by creating assets/css/style.scss that imports the theme and adds CSS or Sass after it. The HTML layout can be overridden by copying the default layout into the site or by adding files to _includes. GitHub-generated URLs such as zip_url can be overridden in _config.yml. The repository also includes a script-based local preview and a small build test suite.
use_cases: create a simple GitHub Pages website
personal or project site with a minimal design
override GitHub Pages download or repository URLs
how_to_run: Add `jekyll-remote-theme` to the plugins list in _config.yml
Optionally add `gem "github-pages", group: :jekyll_plugins` to your Gemfile to preview locally
Run `bundle exec jekyll serve` and visit localhost:4000
notable: Used as a remote theme, so no files need to be copied into the site
Stylesheet customization via a small style.scss importing the theme, with Sass variables overridable before the import
Layout can be overridden selectively through _includes or fully by copying the default layout
Includes a script-based test suite (script/cibuild) to confirm a site builds with the theme
caveats: The README describes a Jekyll theme for GitHub Pages; it does not describe a standalone application
Local preview requires Ruby tooling and the github-pages gem, plus running script/bootstrap
Customizing Sass variables requires setting them before the @import line
